metric.reason: runtime store and effective-threshold evidence is incomplete; only the explicitly labeled policy-threshold proxy is available
metric.thresholdRule: same-section uses the minimum verified runtime effective threshold across the measurement window; when runtime evidence is unavailable the reported policy-threshold proxy uses an explicitly labeled threshold reconstructed from the public index count and policy parameters. Cross-canton unordered pairs use min(left threshold, right threshold), equivalent to exceedance in either direction.
metric.thresholdSource: runtime markers report store.count, model compatibility and effective threshold; when unavailable, policy threshold is reconstructed from the validated public index count and runtime policy parameters when present
metric.productionStoreAvailability: runtime evidence is incomplete or records a fail-open; local files and public binary URLs are not treated as proof of the production store
metric.activeGateRuntimeStatus: a fail-open outcome was observed in the measurement window; M6 also reports the intended policy threshold separately
